implementation_notes: A `Contracts` assembly owned by both teams with `InternalsVisibleTo` for both; a pipeline stage builds both consumers together so an uncoordinated break fails before merge. Use integration tests that run the two contexts against the contract.
idiom_name: jointly-owned Contracts assembly + combined build gate
pitfalls: The Contracts assembly accumulating logic belonging to one context
Building each context separately, so neither build catches the break
